# Random stream source anchors

Read-only upstream references for the TensorFlow translation in
`bayesfilter/ops/ledh_random_compat_tf.py`; never imported at runtime.
NumPy sources are from https://github.com/numpy/numpy/tree/v2.1.3/numpy/random.
TensorFlow headers are from the installed 2.19.1 distribution. Source copyright
and licenses are retained in every original file. The NumPy SeedSequence
and PCG64 translations carry the original MIT permission; the TensorFlow
Box--Muller translation is under Apache-2.0. See NOTICE and the preserved sources.
